system.description:
Beginning at 17th level, your ego has strengthened, and with it, your Void Soul has strengthened as well. Your Void soul gains resistance to two damage types of your choice.

Additionally, while you are gaining the benefit of your Superego Manifestation class feature, you gain one of following additional benefits. You select which benefit when you first enter your Superego Manifestation. Once you select a benefit, you cannot change it until you complete a rest;

Messiah. If a creature would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can spend 1 superiority die. They regain a number of hit points equal to the result, and a number of temporary hit points equal to twice the result.

Izanagi. When you would use a superiority die to use a maneuver, roll it if you did not already. On a roll of 7 or 8, you regain the spent die.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
